# REQ: LANG-441 LANG-442 LANG-443 LANG-444 # syntax=docker/dockerfile:1 ARG GO_VERSION=1.22 FROM golang:${GO_VERSION} AS build WORKDIR /src COPY go.mod go.sum ./ RUN go mod download && \ go build -o /out/app ./cmd/app ENV APP_HOME=/app PATH="$PATH:/app/bin" FROM gcr.io/distroless/static AS final LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title='gohighlightgo' COPY --from=build /out/app $APP_HOME/app EXPOSE 8080 USER nonroot ENTRYPOINT ["/app/app", "--port", "8080"] cmd ["--help"]
